description: Research county property assessments and prepare draft comparisons from available records. Create a private veteran review PDF from a saved review you select, with unanswered questions shown. County records, your answers and any VA information you choose to share are identified separately. Missing building, identity, tax-year, taxable-value or filing evidence can limit the review. Drafts do not complete official forms, establish eligibility or authorize filing. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

review.commerce_description: Untax provides MCP tool execution and structured output. It does not process direct in-chat payments.

negative.prompt: Book a roundtrip flight from New York to London for next week.
Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account immediately.
Add a dentist appointment to my Google Calendar for 3 PM tomorrow.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the selected property records with source links, dates and missing facts. Does not invent values or claim verified savings.
positive.prompt: Research the assessment for a Hamilton County, TN property and show its source and evidence gaps.

positive.description: Test Case 2: Building observations and comparison evidence gaps
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the selected property and explicit answers to show available building facts, missing comparison evidence and the next relevant question.
positive.prompt: Show the retained building observations and comparison evidence gaps for a Hamilton County property.

positive.description: Test Case 3: Address lookup and session scope
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching addresses and asks the user to choose if the property is unclear. Does not treat a match as ownership authority.
positive.prompt: Suggest matching Hamilton County addresses for 100 Market St and explain available research options.

positive.description: Test Case 4: Public VA facility lookup
positive.expected_behavior: Shows available VA facility details, official source links and source dates. Identifies any sample results and leaves missing details unknown.
positive.prompt: Find nearby VA facilities in Tennessee and show official contact and source information.

positive.description: Test Case 5: Official VA form lookup
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching official VA forms, their revision dates and PDF links. Does not claim that a form has been completed or submitted.
positive.prompt: Find official VA forms related to disability compensation and show their revision dates.
